line: Bitcoin drifted higher on the day per the Board's neutral 53 reading even as the week's ETF flows stayed negative, making for a data-only day with no fresh news to color it.
small_line: Written from Bitcoin +0.80% on the day, spot ETF net -7.6M USD (Oct 15, 2026), Fear & Greed 53 (neutral), funding +0.0045% per 8h (calm)

wire_top3.line: Brooklyn DA and FBI dismantled Russian-language crypto scam network, seizing 112 servers and shutting 241 domains after victims lost tens of millions.
EU banking authority classified Circle's USDC as 'significant' e-money token under MiCA, activating Nov. 12 supervisory rules.
Australia's ASIC proposed stricter rules for crypto exchange licensing, including capital and custody requirements due ahead of 2027 rollout.
